Step:  
1011 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
Days in months before target:  
From 11-16 back 224 days.  
First go back 16 days to Nov 1 → 224 - 16 = 208 days left.  
Oct (31) → 208 - 31 = 177  
Sep (30) → 177 - 30 = 147  
Aug (31) → 147 - 31 = 116  
Jul (31) → 116 - 31 = 85  
Jun (30) → 85 - 30 = 55  
May (31) → 55 - 31 = 24  
Apr (30) → 24 - 30 → can’t, so stop before April.  
We have 24 days left after May 1.  
April has 30 days, so 24 days before May 1 = April 30 - 24 days = April 6.  

Check:  
From 1011-04-06 to 1011-11-16:  
Apr: 30-6=24, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 16 → sum:  
24+31=55, +30=85, +31=116, +31=147, +30=177, +31=208, +16=224 days. Correct.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1011-04-06
